name: AtomStack A70 Max
tagline: 70–77W CoS-packaged diode : 850×800 mm flagship Atomstack cutter
tldr: AtomStack A70 Max brings 70–77W compressed diode power to an 850×800 mm frame with auto-focus, touchscreen, and claims of 25 mm wood in one pass. Popular 2024–2025 upgrade path for makers outgrowing A40 Pro : still open-frame, not enclosed.
mainObjective: Maximum Atomstack diode power for large panels and deep wood cuts

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Among the strongest desktop diode packages
Huge work area with 0.01 mm engraving spec
cons: Open frame and flame monitoring still your responsibility
Marketing pass claims need your own material tests
beginnerNotes: Not a first laser : buy after you've outgrown 20–40W. Compare Sculpfun S70 MAX and enclosed Acmer P3 if smoke control matters.
proTips: Plan enclosure and exhaust before ordering : community designs exist for A70 footprint.
primaryUse: Large-format high-power diode for production-style wood and acrylic cutting plus detailed engraving.
